scope: Independent hand-derived PFNC BiColor component/location literals. Authored after reading primary table and stated software policy, before reading candidate bicolor.rs or fixture implementations. No physical/SDK/runtime claim.

primary.proof: Both row1 and row2 are LM,NO,LM,NO. RGBG means measured RG/BG pairs; BGRG means measured BG/RG pairs. Each image position has two components; horizontal position changes phase, vertical position alone does not.
primary.method: Official PDF indexed text table read directly. Web screenshot returned cache-miss; no independent visual-render/hash claim.

software_policy: Preserve measured G and R/B. Fill missing R/B by mean of adjacent in-view opposite-color positions (one-sided at edges); width1 uses measured G. This is an explicit display policy, not PFNC-provided samples/calibration/accuracy. All chosen means are integral, so these vectors do not settle rounding of odd sums.

odd_x_view.qualification: Only in-view neighbors are used. Cropping after full-image interpolation need not equal interpolating a raw view; measured components must agree.

odd_y_view.proof: Odd row width does not carry alternating phase into the next row.

source_descriptor_policy: The original received descriptor and exact row/padding bytes remain source evidence. A derived crop may exchange RGBG/BGRG only on oddx; this does not rewrite original RAW metadata.
